exposure: Normal weight, overweight, and obese groups
Adequate, excessive, and inadequate GWG groups
cohort: 832 nulliparous women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
finding: High pre-pregnancy BMI and excessive GWG were associated with a higher incidence of LGA and other adverse pregnancy outcomes in women with GDM.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were higher in women with high pre-pregnancy BMI.
